Before-citations and word counts use `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. A path-scoped comparison through `88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684` found zero overlap. Keep this leaf to one commit: executable semantics compare that final commit's first parent (`HEAD^`) with `HEAD`. The frozen base now differs from the reviewed parent only by the two legitimate `_NON_MUTATING` census entries `get_local_id_map` and `_issue_local_id_property`; the verifier pins that exact pre-existing delta.

## Boundary and immutable oracle
Below, `R` means `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler`. `D:<qualified-owner>` identifies only that owner's leading string docstring; `C:<anchor>@Lx-y` identifies one contiguous base comment region. Edit only these IDs. Every block must shrink and state current rationale/constraints; preserve cited literals and behavioral oracles.

Parse the final commit's first-parent/final source with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; replace only allowlisted leading docstring values; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact attribute-free AST equality. Separately require the frozen-base-to-first-parent scoped diff to contain exactly the two declared census additions. Tokenize independently to preserve directive/shebang text and inline/next-statement attachment. Runtime strings, inline comments, unlisted prose, executable syntax, and zero-context diff hunks outside the base spans remain exact.

## Scope — 31 editable blocks
